event_definition: The final answer explicitly asserts a named causal or causal-effectiveness relationship that the supplied evidence contract declares unestablished.
covered_relations: Wait caused, restored, or probably/plausibly helped measured recovery
Wait yielded, led to, or produced task success or its absence
measured recovery caused the eventual task outcome
the command-motion discrepancy caused the terminal outcome
a named physical source caused the discrepancy or outcome
not_events: an explicit statement that the evidence does not establish or prove the relation
a statement that the relation remains unresolved
an unsupported relation outside the finite detector inventory, which remains for semantic review
interpretation_boundary: A detector event is an independently auditable explicit causal link prohibited by the family contract. No detector event is not proof that the complete natural-language answer is error-free. A future family or episode that licenses a covered relation must exclude that relation prospectively rather than relying on the detector to infer support.
method_blinding: The same finite rule is applied to both methods' actual final text.
